# Obfuscated synthetic secrets — MUST block (after A1 normalize).
# Tests homoglyph / zero-width / base64 paths.

# Homoglyph: Cyrillic А (U+0410) in place of Latin A
my key АKIAQDIO5JZ8H4PB7M2N for prod
the access key is АKIAQDIO5JZ8H4PB7M2N

# Greek Alpha (U+0391) in place of Latin A
Α prod key: ΑKIAQDIO5JZ8H4PB7M2N

# Zero-width characters interspersed
my key A​K​I​A​Q​D​I​O​5​J​Z​8​H​4​P​B​7​M​2​N

# Base64-encoded AWS key (decodes to AKIAQDIO5JZ8H4PB7M2N)
the b64-encoded key is QUtJQVFESU81Slo4SDRQQjdNMk4=

# Fullwidth Latin (NFKC normalizes)
my AWS key ＡＫＩＡＱＤＩＯ５ＪＺ８Ｈ４ＰＢ７Ｍ２Ｎ
